style.name: Timed
style.desc: Process as many travelers as possible in 10 minutes.
style.bulletin: ENDLESS - TIMED\n\nProcess as many travelers as possible in 10 minutes. One point per traveler. Lose 30 seconds for each citation.

style.name: Perfection
style.desc: Game over at first penalty. Earn dwindling points.
style.bulletin: ENDLESS - PERFECTION\n\nEarn points for processing travelers. No citations allowed. Ten points per traveler in the first minute, one less point for each minute that passes. Work quickly.

style.name: Endurance
style.desc: Play until balance goes negative. Avoid penalties.
style.bulletin: ENDLESS - ENDURANCE\n\nProcess travelers until your balance drops below zero. Citations penalize an escalating number of points. The highest achieved points are remembered for scoring.
